title.zh: House Committee Advances US Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Party-Line Split
title.en: House Committee Advances US Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Party-Line Split

current_state.zh: The House Financial Services Committee advanced the American Reserve Modernization Act, which would codify a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile, on a party-line 28-21 vote.
current_state.en: The House Financial Services Committee advanced the American Reserve Modernization Act, which would codify a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile, on a party-line 28-21 vote.
